product_one_liner.value: Aviatrix provides businesses with a secure cloud-networking platform for connecting multicloud environments and protecting network and workload traffic with zero-trust controls.

pricing_page.notes: The public page provides pricing information for Aviatrix Clearance.

employee_band.notes: LinkedIn reports a company-size band of 201–500 employees.

eng_blog.notes: The engineering publication includes a technical post by Aviatrix Chief Scientist Susan Hinrichs; a separate data-plane architecture post is by Tim McConnaughy, a Technical Marketing Engineer.

public_docs.notes: The public documentation site includes product guides and an API reference.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The open job list was reviewed; none of the listed titles is an AI, ML, or data-science role.

model_provider.notes: Aviatrix says it uses OpenRouter to access multiple underlying model providers; the specific models are not named.

compliance_certs.notes: These are the named badges on Aviatrix's trust page; GDPR is included because it is named there.

last_funding.notes: The funding history identifies the Series E as the latest round; the announcement is dated September 8, 2021.

raised_18mo.notes: The latest identified round was announced in September 2021, before the 18-month window.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The open jobs list includes a Strategic Account Executive posting.

launched_6mo.notes: Aviatrix announced Harvest and Decrypt Protection on September 22, 2026.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: The available leadership page is not complete enough to check all C-level or VP-level start dates, and no dated in-window joining or departure announcement was verified.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The job posting names Salesforce CRM and lists Outreach.io and/or Salesloft as sales-engagement tools.
